text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #486174

g.text: Copenhagen · Oslo · Stockholm · frozen operational geography
Public frozen study masks and provider operational neighbourhood polygons used for primary validation. Municipal masks are membership geometry, not
validation units. No individual listings. Inside Airbnb, CC BY4.0; accepted mask sources/vintages are in the source registry. Panel extents differ.
